spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m8p6t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Clerks, MinShelf, MaxShelf

Titles == {"titleAtlas", "titleBeacon"}
FreeLock == "freeLock"
NoClerk == "noClerk"

VARIABLES branchLock, titleLock, heldFor, shelfCap

vars == <<branchLock, titleLock, heldFor, shelfCap>>

Standing == {t \in Titles : heldFor[t] # NoClerk}

TypeOK ==
    /\ branchLock \in Clerks \cup {FreeLock}
    /\ titleLock \in [Titles -> Clerks \cup {FreeLock}]
    /\ heldFor \in [Titles -> Clerks \cup {NoClerk}]
    /\ shelfCap \in MinShelf..MaxShelf

Init ==
    /\ branchLock = FreeLock
    /\ titleLock = [t \in Titles |-> FreeLock]
    /\ heldFor = [t \in Titles |-> NoClerk]
    /\ shelfCap = MaxShelf

TakeBranchLock(c) ==
    /\ branchLock = FreeLock
    /\ branchLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<titleLock, heldFor, shelfCap>>

TakeTitleLock(c, t) ==
    /\ branchLock = c
    /\ titleLock[t] = FreeLock
    /\ titleLock' = [titleLock EXCEPT ![t] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<branchLock, heldFor, shelfCap>>

PlaceHold(c, t) ==
    /\ titleLock[t] = c
    /\ heldFor[t] = NoClerk
    /\ Cardinality(Standing) < shelfCap
    /\ heldFor' = [heldFor EXCEPT ![t] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<branchLock, titleLock, shelfCap>>

PatronCollects(t) ==
    /\ heldFor[t] # NoClerk
    /\ heldFor' = [heldFor EXCEPT ![t] = NoClerk]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<branchLock, titleLock, shelfCap>>

DropAllLocks(c) ==
    /\ branchLock = c
    /\ \A t \in Titles : heldFor[t] # c
    /\ branchLock' = FreeLock
    /\ titleLock' = [t \in Titles |-> IF titleLock[t] = c THEN FreeLock ELSE titleLock[t]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldFor, shelfCap>>

WheelInUnit ==
    /\ shelfCap < MaxShelf
    /\ shelfCap' = shelfCap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<branchLock, titleLock, heldFor>>

WheelOutUnit ==
    /\ shelfCap > MinShelf
    /\ Cardinality(Standing) < shelfCap
    /\ shelfCap' = shelfCap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<branchLock, titleLock, heldFor>>

Next ==
    \/ WheelInUnit \/ WheelOutUnit
    \/ \E c \in Clerks : TakeBranchLock(c) \/ DropAllLocks(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clerks, t \in Titles : TakeTitleLock(c, t) \/ PlaceHold(c, t)
    \/ \E t \in Titles : PatronCollects(t)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(PatronCollects("titleAtlas"))
    /\ WF_vars(PatronCollects("titleBeacon"))

HoldsBelongToLockHolder ==
    \A t \in Titles : heldFor[t] # NoClerk => titleLock[t] = heldFor[t]

HoldsAreAlwaysCollected ==
    \A t \in Titles : (heldFor[t] # NoClerk) ~> (heldFor[t] = NoClerk)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Clerks = {clkOne, clkTwo}
    MinShelf = 1
    MaxShelf = 2
INVARIANT HoldsBelongToLockHolder
PROPERTY HoldsAreAlwaysCollected
nl:
A library book reservation system lets desk clerks put holds on titles and park the copies
on the reservation shelf behind the desk. The shelf is the constrained resource, and its
size changes through the day: shelving units are wheeled in and out, so the number of holds
that can stand at once goes up and down while the desk is working.

Holds are placed under two levels of lock, coarse before fine. A clerk takes the branch
lock first, which covers the whole reservation desk, and only while holding it may it take
the lock on a particular title. The branch lock is kept, not handed back, until the clerk
drops everything at once. A clerk holding a title's lock may place a hold on that title,
provided nothing is already held on it and the shelf has room under whatever capacity is
in force at that moment; the hold stands in that clerk's name. A patron collects a hold
from the shelf, which clears it.

A clerk drops the branch lock and all of its title locks together, and it may only do that
once no hold anywhere stands in its name -- a clerk never walks away leaving a hold behind
under a lock it no longer holds.

Shelving units are wheeled in at any time. A unit may only be wheeled out while the holds
already standing still fit in the reduced shelf.

Actions: a clerk takes the free branch lock; a clerk holding the branch lock takes a free
title lock; a clerk holding a title lock places a hold on that title while the shelf has
room; a patron collects a standing hold; a clerk with no holds in its name drops the
branch lock and all its title locks; a shelving unit is wheeled in, raising capacity; a
shelving unit is wheeled out, lowering capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every hold standing on the reservation shelf is in the name of the clerk
that currently holds that title's lock, so no hold is ever left standing for a clerk that
has dropped its locks and walked away.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every hold that is placed on the shelf is eventually cleared, so no
title stays held forever.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m7p4t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANT SeatCap

Matchers == {"regionEast", "regionWest"}
Servers == {"srvAurora", "srvBoreal"}
NoServer == "noServer"
NoRead == [srv |-> NoServer, saw |-> 0]

VARIABLES seatReg, connected, reading, holding

vars == <<seatReg, connected, reading, holding>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ seatReg \in [Servers -> 0..SeatCap]
    /\ connected \in [Servers -> 0..SeatCap]
    /\ reading \in [Matchers -> [srv : Servers \cup {NoServer}, saw : 0..SeatCap]]
    /\ holding \in [Matchers -> Servers \cup {NoServer}]

Init ==
    /\ seatReg = [s \in Servers |-> 0]
    /\ connected = [s \in Servers |-> 0]
    /\ reading = [m \in Matchers |-> NoRead]
    /\ holding = [m \in Matchers |-> NoServer]

ReadSeatRegister(m, s) ==
    /\ reading[m] = NoRead
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![m] = [srv |-> s, saw |-> seatReg[s]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seatReg, connected, holding>>

SeatTaken(m) ==
    /\ reading[m] # NoRead
    /\ holding[m] = NoServer
    /\ LET s == reading[m].srv IN
       /\ seatReg[s] = reading[m].saw
       /\ seatReg[s] < SeatCap
       /\ seatReg' = [seatReg EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
       /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![m] = s]
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![m] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED connected

AttemptMisses(m) ==
    /\ reading[m] # NoRead
    /\ \/ holding[m] # NoServer
       \/ seatReg[reading[m].srv] # reading[m].saw
       \/ seatReg[reading[m].srv] = SeatCap
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![m] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seatReg, connected, holding>>

PlayerConnects(m) ==
    /\ holding[m] # NoServer
    /\ connected' = [connected EXCEPT ![holding[m]] = @ + 1]
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![m] = NoServer]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seatReg, reading>>

ReservationAbandoned(m) ==
    /\ holding[m] # NoServer
    /\ seatReg' = [seatReg EXCEPT ![holding[m]] = @ - 1]
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![m] = NoServer]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<connected, reading>>

PlayerLeaves(s) ==
    /\ connected[s] > 0
    /\ connected' = [connected EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ seatReg' = [seatReg EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reading, holding>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Matchers, s \in Servers : ReadSeatRegister(m, s)
    \/ \E m \in Matchers : SeatTaken(m) \/ AttemptMisses(m) \/ PlayerConnects(m)
                           \/ ReservationAbandoned(m)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : PlayerLeaves(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SeatCapNeverBreached ==
    \A s \in Servers :
        connected[s] + Cardinality({m \in Matchers : holding[m] = s}) <= SeatCap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    SeatCap = 2
INVARIANT SeatCapNeverBreached
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker runs as two entirely independent regional matchmakers
that happen to place players onto the same pool of game servers. They share no queue and
no plan; each just tries to seat its own players. Every server has a hard seat cap, and
that cap is what must never be breached.

Seats are taken through a compare-and-swap seat register kept on each server. A matchmaker
reads a server's register and remembers the value it saw. It may then take a seat only if
the register still reads exactly what it remembered and the server is not already at its
cap; taking the seat ticks the register up and gives the matchmaker a reservation on that
server. If the register has moved since the read -- the other region got there first -- or
the server has filled, the attempt misses and the matchmaker throws the read away and
starts again. A matchmaker carries at most one reservation at a time.

A reservation is turned into a player actually connected to the server, or it is abandoned,
which gives its seat back on the register. When a player leaves the match, the seat comes
back on the register too.

Actions: a matchmaker reads a server's seat register; a matchmaker whose read still matches
takes a seat and gains a reservation; a matchmaker's attempt misses and it throws away the
read; a matchmaker turns its reservation into a connected player; a matchmaker abandons its
reservation, returning the seat; a connected player leaves the match, returning the seat.

SAFETY PROPERTY: On every server, the players actually connected plus the reservations the
two regional matchmakers are still holding for that server never exceed the server's seat
cap.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p2t0 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS TotalCopies, StampRing

Clerks == {"clerkIvy", "clerkJon"}
Places == {"stacks", "holdShelf", "onLoan"}
NoRead == StampRing

VARIABLES atPlace, inHands, stamp, remembered, gone

vars == <<atPlace, inHands, stamp, remembered, gone>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ atPlace \in [Places -> 0..TotalCopies]
    /\ inHands \subseteq Clerks
    /\ stamp \in 0..(StampRing - 1)
    /\ remembered \in [Clerks -> 0..StampRing]
    /\ gone \subseteq Clerks

Init ==
    /\ atPlace = [p \in Places |-> IF p = "stacks" THEN TotalCopies ELSE 0]
    /\ inHands = {}
    /\ stamp = 0
    /\ remembered = [c \in Clerks |-> NoRead]
    /\ gone = {}

ReadStamp(c) ==
    /\ c \notin gone
    /\ remembered[c] = NoRead
    /\ remembered' = [remembered EXCEPT ![c] = stamp]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<atPlace, inHands, stamp, gone>>

LiftCopy(c, p) ==
    /\ c \notin gone
    /\ remembered[c] = stamp
    /\ c \notin inHands
    /\ atPlace[p] > 0
    /\ atPlace' = [atPlace EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
    /\ inHands' = inHands \cup {c}
    /\ stamp' = (stamp + 1) % StampRing
    /\ remembered' = [remembered EXCEPT ![c] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED gone

ThrowAwayReading(c) ==
    /\ remembered[c] # NoRead
    /\ remembered[c] # stamp
    /\ remembered' = [remembered EXCEPT ![c] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<atPlace, inHands, stamp, gone>>

PutCopyDown(c, p) ==
    /\ c \notin gone
    /\ c \in inHands
    /\ atPlace' = [atPlace EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1]
    /\ inHands' = inHands \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stamp, remembered, gone>>

CrashSilently(c) ==
    /\ c \notin gone
    /\ gone' = gone \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<atPlace, inHands, stamp, remembered>>

PorterSweeps(c) ==
    /\ c \in gone
    /\ c \in inHands
    /\ atPlace' = [atPlace EXCEPT !["stacks"] = @ + 1]
    /\ inHands' = inHands \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stamp, remembered, gone>>

BackOnShift(c) ==
    /\ c \in gone
    /\ c \notin inHands
    /\ gone' = gone \ {c}
    /\ remembered' = [remembered EXCEPT ![c] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<atPlace, inHands, stamp>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Clerks : ReadStamp(c) \/ ThrowAwayReading(c) \/ CrashSilently(c)
                         \/ PorterSweeps(c) \/ BackOnShift(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clerks, p \in Places : LiftCopy(c, p) \/ PutCopyDown(c, p)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(PutCopyDown("clerkIvy", "stacks") \/ PorterSweeps("clerkIvy"))
    /\ WF_vars(PutCopyDown("clerkJon", "stacks") \/ PorterSweeps("clerkJon"))

CopiesAreConserved ==
    atPlace["stacks"] + atPlace["holdShelf"] + atPlace["onLoan"]
        + Cardinality(inHands) = TotalCopies

HandsAreEmptied ==
    \A c \in Clerks : (c \in inHands) ~> (c \notin inHands)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    TotalCopies = 3
    StampRing = 3
INVARIANT CopiesAreConserved
PROPERTY HandsAreEmptied
nl:
A library book reservation system tracks a fixed set of physical copies of a title. Every
copy is at any moment in exactly one of four places: out in the stacks, standing on the
reservation shelf behind the desk, out on loan to a borrower, or in a clerk's hands while
it is being moved. Copies are neither acquired nor withdrawn during the day, so the count
of them cannot change.

Moving a copy is done optimistically rather than under a lock. The circulation ledger
carries a version stamp. A clerk reads the stamp and remembers it, and may lift a copy out
of one of the three places only if the stamp still reads exactly what it remembered; the
lift ticks the stamp. A clerk whose remembered stamp has been overtaken throws the reading
away and reads again. A clerk carries at most one copy. A copy in a clerk's hands is put
down into whichever of the three places the clerk is heading for.

A clerk can crash silently -- walk off shift mid-move without telling anyone -- and may do
so with a copy still in hand. Nothing announces this. The floor porter sweeps up after a
crashed clerk: the copy in that clerk's hands goes back out into the stacks. A crashed
clerk who is carrying nothing can come back on shift.

Actions: a clerk reads the ledger's version stamp; a clerk whose reading still matches
lifts a copy out of one of the three places and ticks the stamp; a clerk throws away a
reading the stamp has overtaken; a clerk puts the copy in hand down into one of the three
places; a clerk crashes silently; the porter sweeps a crashed clerk's copy back into the
stacks; a crashed, empty-handed clerk comes back on shift.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The copies in the stacks, plus the copies on the reservation shelf, plus
the copies out on loan, plus the copies in clerks' hands always add up to the title's total
copy count, so no move, stale-read retry, crash, or sweep ever creates or loses a copy.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Any copy in a clerk's hands eventually leaves those hands, so no copy
is carried around indefinitely.

spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m4p2t3 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS TotalBags, QueueCap

Chutes == {"chuteAlpha", "chuteBravo"}
Handlers == {"handlerAlpha", "handlerBravo"}
ChuteOf == [handlerAlpha |-> "chuteAlpha", handlerBravo |-> "chuteBravo"]

VARIABLES infeed, sortQueue, chute, loaded, goneSlow

vars == <<infeed, sortQueue, chute, loaded, goneSlow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ infeed \in 0..TotalBags
    /\ sortQueue \in Seq(Chutes)
    /\ chute \in [Chutes -> 0..TotalBags]
    /\ loaded \in 0..TotalBags
    /\ goneSlow \subseteq Handlers

Init ==
    /\ infeed = TotalBags
    /\ sortQueue = << >>
    /\ chute = [c \in Chutes |-> 0]
    /\ loaded = 0
    /\ goneSlow = {}

AdmitToSortation(c) ==
    /\ infeed > 0
    /\ Len(sortQueue) < QueueCap
    /\ infeed' = infeed - 1
    /\ sortQueue' = Append(sortQueue, c)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<chute, loaded, goneSlow>>

DropIntoChute ==
    /\ Len(sortQueue) > 0
    /\ chute' = [chute EXCEPT ![Head(sortQueue)] = @ + 1]
    /\ sortQueue' = Tail(sortQueue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<infeed, loaded, goneSlow>>

HandlerLoads(h) ==
    /\ h \notin goneSlow
    /\ chute[ChuteOf[h]] > 0
    /\ chute' = [chute EXCEPT ![ChuteOf[h]] = @ - 1]
    /\ loaded' = loaded + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<infeed, sortQueue, goneSlow>>

PulledForRescan ==
    /\ loaded > 0
    /\ loaded' = loaded - 1
    /\ infeed' = infeed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sortQueue, chute, goneSlow>>

GoSlow(h) ==
    /\ h \notin goneSlow
    /\ goneSlow' = goneSlow \cup {h}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<infeed, sortQueue, chute, loaded>>

BackUpToSpeed(h) ==
    /\ h \in goneSlow
    /\ goneSlow' = goneSlow \ {h}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<infeed, sortQueue, chute, loaded>>

Next ==
    \/ DropIntoChute \/ PulledForRescan
    \/ \E c \in Chutes : AdmitToSortation(c)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers : HandlerLoads(h) \/ GoSlow(h) \/ BackUpToSpeed(h)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BagsAreConserved ==
    infeed + Len(sortQueue) + chute["chuteAlpha"] + chute["chuteBravo"] + loaded = TotalBags
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    TotalBags = 3
    QueueCap = 2
INVARIANT BagsAreConserved
nl:
An airport baggage router moves a fixed set of bags from the check-in infeed to the
aircraft. A bag is at any moment in exactly one place: waiting on the infeed, riding the
bounded sortation queue, sitting in one of the two make-up chutes, or already loaded. Bags
are neither created nor destroyed by the router; a bag pulled off an aircraft for a rescan
simply goes back to the infeed.

The sortation queue is bounded and applies backpressure: while it holds its full number of
bags nothing more is admitted from the infeed, and admitted bags leave the queue in the
order they entered. A bag admitted onto the queue carries the chute it is destined for,
and when it reaches the front of the queue it drops into that chute.

Each chute is worked by a handler who lifts bags out of it and loads them. Handlers here
are slow, never failed: a handler can go slow, during which it loads nothing at all, and it
comes back up to speed on its own. Nothing is ever taken away from a slow handler and no
other handler covers its chute; the bags simply wait in the chute until the handler is
back.

Actions: a bag is admitted from the infeed onto the tail of the sortation queue while the
queue has room; the bag at the front of the queue drops into its destination chute; a
handler that is up to speed lifts a bag out of its chute and loads it; a loaded bag is
pulled back to the infeed for a rescan; a handler goes slow; a handler comes back up to
speed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The bags waiting on the infeed, plus the bags riding the sortation queue,
plus the bags sitting in the two make-up chutes, plus the bags already loaded always add up
to the router's total bag count.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m5p0t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Instances == {"baseBuilding", "tenantFitOut"}
Sensors == {"shaftLow", "shaftMid", "shaftHigh"}
Nobody == "nobody"

VARIABLES heldBy, running, tally, wanting

vars == <<heldBy, running, tally, wanting>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ heldBy \in Instances \cup {Nobody}
    /\ running \in Instances \cup {Nobody}
    /\ tally \in [Instances -> SUBSET Sensors]
    /\ wanting \subseteq Instances

Init ==
    /\ heldBy = Nobody
    /\ running = Nobody
    /\ tally = [i \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ wanting = {}

RaiseRequest(i) ==
    /\ i \notin wanting
    /\ wanting' = wanting \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, running, tally>>

SensorVotes(s, i) ==
    /\ heldBy = Nobody
    /\ i \in wanting
    /\ s \notin tally[i]
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, running, wanting>>

GrantHoistway(i) ==
    /\ heldBy = Nobody
    /\ i \in wanting
    /\ Cardinality(tally[i]) * 2 > Cardinality(Sensors)
    /\ heldBy' = i
    /\ tally' = [j \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<running, wanting>>

StartCarRun(i) ==
    /\ heldBy = i
    /\ running = Nobody
    /\ running' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, tally, wanting>>

FinishCarRun(i) ==
    /\ running = i
    /\ running' = Nobody
    /\ wanting' = wanting \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, tally>>

GiveBackHoistway(i) ==
    /\ heldBy = i
    /\ running # i
    /\ heldBy' = Nobody
    /\ UNCHANGED <<running, tally, wanting>>

DiscardStaleTally(i) ==
    /\ heldBy # Nobody
    /\ tally[i] # {}
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBy, running, wanting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Sensors, i \in Instances : SensorVotes(s, i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances :
           \/ RaiseRequest(i) \/ GrantHoistway(i) \/ StartCarRun(i)
           \/ FinishCarRun(i) \/ GiveBackHoistway(i) \/ DiscardStaleTally(i)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(FinishCarRun("baseBuilding"))
    /\ WF_vars(FinishCarRun("tenantFitOut"))

RunnerHoldsTheHoistway == running # Nobody => heldBy = running

RunsAlwaysFinish == (running # Nobody) ~> (running = Nobody)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT RunnerHoldsTheHoistway
PROPERTY RunsAlwaysFinish
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper is driven by two entirely independent building-management
instances -- the base-building system and the tenant fit-out system -- which share one
express hoistway. Neither knows the other's schedule. The express hoistway is the critical
resource: only one instance may be running a car in it at a time.

The hoistway is not handed out by either instance. Three shaft sensors vote. An instance
that wants the hoistway raises a request, and while the hoistway is unheld the sensors vote
for it one at a time. Once a strict majority of the sensors have voted for a requesting
instance, and the hoistway is still unheld, it is granted to that instance and the whole
tally is wiped so the next round starts clean. A tally that was being gathered while the
hoistway got taken is simply discarded.

The instance holding the hoistway starts a car run in it, and finishes that run, which also
retires its request. An instance may also give the hoistway back without running, as long
as it is not mid-run.

Actions: an instance raises a request for the express hoistway; a shaft sensor votes for a
requesting instance while the hoistway is unheld; the hoistway is granted to an instance
with a majority of sensor votes and the tally is wiped; the holding instance starts a car
run; a running instance finishes its run and retires its request; the holding instance
gives the hoistway back without running; a stale tally is discarded once the hoistway is
held.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any instance running a car in the express hoistway is the instance the
sensors have granted the hoistway to, so the two independent instances can never both be
running cars in it.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every car run started in the express hoistway eventually finishes, so
the hoistway is never left with a run under way forever.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m2p5t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MinBudget, MaxBudget

Feeders == {"fdrMill", "fdrQuay", "fdrRidge"}
Participants == {"subEast", "subWest"}
NoFeeder == "noFeeder"

VARIABLES proposed, tally, prepared, opened, shedBudget

vars == <<proposed, tally, prepared, opened, shedBudget>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposed \in Feeders \cup {NoFeeder}
    /\ tally \subseteq Participants
    /\ prepared \subseteq Feeders
    /\ opened \subseteq Feeders
    /\ shedBudget \in MinBudget..MaxBudget

Init ==
    /\ proposed = NoFeeder
    /\ tally = {}
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ opened = {}
    /\ shedBudget = MinBudget

ProposeDrop(f) ==
    /\ proposed = NoFeeder
    /\ f \notin opened
    /\ f \notin prepared
    /\ proposed' = f
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, opened, shedBudget>>

VoteForDrop(p) ==
    /\ proposed # NoFeeder
    /\ p \notin tally
    /\ tally' = tally \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, prepared, opened, shedBudget>>

MoveToPrepared ==
    /\ proposed # NoFeeder
    /\ tally = Participants
    /\ proposed \notin prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {proposed}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, tally, opened, shedBudget>>

CommitDrop ==
    /\ proposed # NoFeeder
    /\ proposed \in prepared
    /\ Cardinality(opened) < shedBudget
    /\ opened' = opened \cup {proposed}
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {proposed}
    /\ proposed' = NoFeeder
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED shedBudget

AbortTransaction ==
    /\ proposed # NoFeeder
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {proposed}
    /\ proposed' = NoFeeder
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<opened, shedBudget>>

RaiseBudget ==
    /\ shedBudget < MaxBudget
    /\ shedBudget' = shedBudget + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, tally, prepared, opened>>

LowerBudget ==
    /\ shedBudget > MinBudget
    /\ Cardinality(opened) <= shedBudget - 1
    /\ shedBudget' = shedBudget - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, tally, prepared, opened>>

Next ==
    \/ MoveToPrepared \/ CommitDrop \/ AbortTransaction \/ RaiseBudget \/ LowerBudget
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : ProposeDrop(f)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : VoteForDrop(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PreparedAndOpenAreDisjoint == prepared \cap opened = {}
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MinBudget = 1
    MaxBudget = 2
INVARIANT PreparedAndOpenAreDisjoint
nl:
A power-grid load shedder drops feeders when the grid is short. Dropping a feeder is
irreversible for the duration of the event: once its breaker has been opened, that feeder
stays open, so a feeder must never be opened twice.

Each drop is agreed by two-phase commit across the substation participants. The coordinator
proposes one feeder at a time -- and only a feeder that is neither already open nor already
held by a proposal in flight. Each participant votes on the proposal. Once every
participant has voted for it, the proposal moves to prepared: the feeder is now locked by
the in-flight transaction, though its breaker is still closed. The transaction then
commits, which opens the breaker: the feeder leaves the prepared set and joins the open
set in one step, and the coordinator goes idle. A transaction can be aborted at any point
before it commits, whether or not it reached prepared, which releases the feeder and clears
the tally.

The grid's shed budget changes while the event runs, as reserve comes and goes: the budget
is raised and lowered by the system operator. The budget is enforced at the moment of
commit -- a transaction only commits while the number of already-open feeders is below the
budget in force right then -- and the operator may only lower the budget to a level the
already-open feeders still fit within.

Actions: the coordinator proposes a feeder that is neither open nor held; a participant
votes for the open proposal; a fully-voted proposal moves to prepared, locking its feeder;
a prepared transaction commits, opening the feeder's breaker while the shed budget allows;
a transaction is aborted, releasing its feeder and clearing the tally; the operator raises
the shed budget; the operator lowers the shed budget.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No feeder is ever both locked by a prepared transaction and already open,
so no in-flight drop can ever land on a breaker that has already been opened.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m0p6t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS MaxRevision, SlotCount, MinStaffed

Surgeons == {"srgHale", "srgIsaacs"}
Slots == 1..SlotCount
NoOne == "noOne"
NoSlot == 0
FreeSlot == [by |-> NoOne, at |-> 0]

VARIABLES revision, holdsRev, booking, attempt, staffed

vars == <<revision, holdsRev, booking, attempt, staffed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ revision \in 0..MaxRevision
    /\ holdsRev \in [Surgeons -> 0..MaxRevision]
    /\ booking \in [Slots -> [by : Surgeons \cup {NoOne}, at : 0..MaxRevision]]
    /\ attempt \in [Surgeons -> Slots \cup {NoSlot}]
    /\ staffed \in MinStaffed..SlotCount

Init ==
    /\ revision = 0
    /\ holdsRev = [x \in Surgeons |-> 0]
    /\ booking = [s \in Slots |-> FreeSlot]
    /\ attempt = [x \in Surgeons |-> NoSlot]
    /\ staffed = SlotCount

PublishRevision ==
    /\ revision < MaxRevision
    /\ revision' = revision + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holdsRev, booking, attempt, staffed>>

PullDownList(x) ==
    /\ holdsRev[x] # revision
    /\ holdsRev' = [holdsRev EXCEPT ![x] = revision]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, booking, attempt, staffed>>

LodgeAttempt(x, s) ==
    /\ attempt[x] = NoSlot
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![x] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, holdsRev, booking, staffed>>

AttemptAccepted(x) ==
    /\ attempt[x] # NoSlot
    /\ holdsRev[x] = revision
    /\ booking[attempt[x]].by = NoOne
    /\ attempt[x] <= staffed
    /\ booking' = [booking EXCEPT ![attempt[x]] = [by |-> x, at |-> revision]]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![x] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, holdsRev, staffed>>

AttemptRejected(x) ==
    /\ attempt[x] # NoSlot
    /\ \/ holdsRev[x] # revision
       \/ booking[attempt[x]].by # NoOne
       \/ attempt[x] > staffed
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![x] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, holdsRev, booking, staffed>>

ReleaseBooking(s) ==
    /\ booking[s].by # NoOne
    /\ booking' = [booking EXCEPT ![s] = FreeSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, holdsRev, attempt, staffed>>

StaffTheatre ==
    /\ staffed < SlotCount
    /\ staffed' = staffed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, holdsRev, booking, attempt>>

CloseTheatre ==
    /\ staffed > MinStaffed
    /\ booking[staffed].by = NoOne
    /\ staffed' = staffed - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, holdsRev, booking, attempt>>

Next ==
    \/ PublishRevision \/ StaffTheatre \/ CloseTheatre
    \/ \E x \in Surgeons : PullDownList(x) \/ AttemptAccepted(x) \/ AttemptRejected(x)
    \/ \E x \in Surgeons, s \in Slots : LodgeAttempt(x, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : ReleaseBooking(s)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(AttemptAccepted("srgHale") \/ AttemptRejected("srgHale"))
    /\ WF_vars(AttemptAccepted("srgIsaacs") \/ AttemptRejected("srgIsaacs"))

LiveBookingsAreCurrent ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        (booking[s].by # NoOne /\ booking[s].at = revision) => holdsRev[booking[s].by] = revision

AttemptsAreResolved ==
    \A x \in Surgeons : (attempt[x] # NoSlot) ~> (attempt[x] = NoSlot)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MaxRevision = 2
    SlotCount = 2
    MinStaffed = 1
INVARIANT LiveBookingsAreCurrent
PROPERTY AttemptsAreResolved
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler publishes a master theatre list, and every publication
carries a revision number. Surgeons work from whatever revision they last pulled down, so a
surgeon may be holding a revision the scheduler has already moved past.

Booking a slot is optimistic: nothing is locked. A surgeon lodges an attempt on a slot, and
the scheduler resolves it afterwards. The attempt is accepted only if the surgeon's held
revision is still the published one, the slot is still unbooked, and the slot is within the
number of theatres currently staffed; acceptance writes the surgeon's name onto the slot
together with the revision it was booked under. Otherwise the attempt is rejected and the
surgeon drops it, typically pulling down the current revision and lodging a fresh attempt.
A booking can be released, freeing the slot again.

Staffing changes through the day, so the number of theatres in service goes up and down. A
theatre is only taken out of service while its slot is unbooked.

Actions: the scheduler publishes a new revision of the theatre list; a surgeon pulls down
the published revision; a surgeon lodges a booking attempt on a slot; an attempt is
accepted and the slot is written with the surgeon and the revision; an attempt is rejected
and dropped; a booking is released; a theatre is brought into service; an unbooked theatre
is taken out of service.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any booking still stamped with the currently published revision was made
by a surgeon who is holding that same published revision, so a surgeon working from a
superseded theatre list never has a live booking on the board.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every booking attempt a surgeon lodges is eventually resolved, so no
attempt sits unanswered forever.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m4p5t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANT WorklistCap

Runs == {"domesticRun", "correspondentRun"}
Instructions == {"payAlfa", "payBravo", "payCharlie"}
Unclaimed == "unclaimed"

VARIABLES claim, worklist, book, paused

vars == <<claim, worklist, book, paused>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ claim \in [Instructions -> Runs \cup {Unclaimed}]
    /\ worklist \in [Runs -> SUBSET Instructions]
    /\ book \in [Runs -> SUBSET Instructions]
    /\ paused \subseteq Runs

Init ==
    /\ claim = [x \in Instructions |-> Unclaimed]
    /\ worklist = [r \in Runs |-> {}]
    /\ book = [r \in Runs |-> {}]
    /\ paused = {}

TakeClaim(r, x) ==
    /\ r \notin paused
    /\ claim[x] = Unclaimed
    /\ Cardinality(worklist[r]) < WorklistCap
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![x] = r]
    /\ worklist' = [worklist EXCEPT ![r] = @ \cup {x}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, paused>>

SettleIntoBook(r, x) ==
    /\ r \notin paused
    /\ x \in worklist[r]
    /\ book' = [book EXCEPT ![r] = @ \cup {x}]
    /\ worklist' = [worklist EXCEPT ![r] = @ \ {x}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, paused>>

DropClaim(r, x) ==
    /\ x \in worklist[r]
    /\ \A q \in Runs : x \notin book[q]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![x] = Unclaimed]
    /\ worklist' = [worklist EXCEPT ![r] = @ \ {x}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, paused>>

PauseRun(r) ==
    /\ r \notin paused
    /\ paused' = paused \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, worklist, book>>

ResumeRun(r) ==
    /\ r \in paused
    /\ paused' = paused \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, worklist, book>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Runs, x \in Instructions :
           TakeClaim(r, x) \/ SettleIntoBook(r, x) \/ DropClaim(r, x)
    \/ \E r \in Runs : PauseRun(r) \/ ResumeRun(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BooksNeverOverlap == book["domesticRun"] \cap book["correspondentRun"] = {}
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    WorklistCap = 2
INVARIANT BooksNeverOverlap
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is worked by two independent settlement runs -- the
domestic real-time run and the correspondent run -- which share one pool of payment
instructions. The runs have no common scheduler and keep their own books of what they have
settled. Settling an instruction moves real money and cannot be undone, so an instruction
must never be settled by both runs.

The pool is guarded by a claim register: every instruction has at most one claim on it, and
a run must take that claim before the instruction goes anywhere near its worklist. A run
takes a claim and puts the instruction on its own bounded worklist in one step, and its
worklist is real backpressure: a run at its worklist limit takes no further claims until
it has cleared something. A run settles an instruction from its worklist into its own book,
which takes the instruction off the worklist. The claim is not given back on settlement --
a settled instruction stays claimed by the run that settled it, for good.

A run that decides not to settle an instruction it has claimed drops it: the instruction
comes off that run's worklist and its claim goes back, so the other run may take it. Only
an unsettled instruction can be dropped this way.

Either run's operator can pause it for maintenance and bring it back; a paused run takes no
claims and settles nothing.

Actions: a run that is not paused takes the free claim on an instruction and puts it on its
worklist, while its worklist has room; a run settles an instruction from its worklist into
its own book; a run drops an unsettled instruction it has claimed, returning the claim; a
run is paused; a paused run is brought back.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The domestic run's book and the correspondent run's book never have an
instruction in common, so no payment is ever settled twice.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m8p0t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

Hosts == {"hostRookery", "hostSpire"}
Brackets == {"bracketBronze", "bracketGold"}
FreeLock == "freeLock"
Nobody == "nobody"
NoBracket == "noBracket"
LadderIdle == [by |-> Nobody, bracket |-> NoBracket]

VARIABLES regionLock, bracketLock, ladderWrite, slowSpell

vars == <<regionLock, bracketLock, ladderWrite, slowSpell>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ regionLock \in Hosts \cup {FreeLock}
    /\ bracketLock \in [Brackets -> Hosts \cup {FreeLock}]
    /\ ladderWrite \in [by : Hosts \cup {Nobody}, bracket : Brackets \cup {NoBracket}]
    /\ slowSpell \subseteq Hosts

Init ==
    /\ regionLock = FreeLock
    /\ bracketLock = [b \in Brackets |-> FreeLock]
    /\ ladderWrite = LadderIdle
    /\ slowSpell = {}

TakeRegionLock(h) ==
    /\ h \notin slowSpell
    /\ regionLock = FreeLock
    /\ regionLock' = h
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bracketLock, ladderWrite, slowSpell>>

TakeBracketLock(h, b) ==
    /\ h \notin slowSpell
    /\ regionLock = h
    /\ bracketLock[b] = FreeLock
    /\ bracketLock' = [bracketLock EXCEPT ![b] = h]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, ladderWrite, slowSpell>>

BeginLadderWrite(h, b) ==
    /\ h \notin slowSpell
    /\ regionLock = h
    /\ bracketLock[b] = h
    /\ ladderWrite.by = Nobody
    /\ ladderWrite' = [by |-> h, bracket |-> b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, bracketLock, slowSpell>>

EndLadderWrite(h) ==
    /\ h \notin slowSpell
    /\ ladderWrite.by = h
    /\ ladderWrite' = LadderIdle
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, bracketLock, slowSpell>>

DropLocks(h) ==
    /\ h \notin slowSpell
    /\ regionLock = h
    /\ ladderWrite.by # h
    /\ regionLock' = FreeLock
    /\ bracketLock' = [b \in Brackets |-> IF bracketLock[b] = h THEN FreeLock ELSE bracketLock[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ladderWrite, slowSpell>>

FallSlow(h) ==
    /\ h \notin slowSpell
    /\ slowSpell' = slowSpell \cup {h}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, bracketLock, ladderWrite>>

ComeBack(h) ==
    /\ h \in slowSpell
    /\ slowSpell' = slowSpell \ {h}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, bracketLock, ladderWrite>>

Next ==
    \/ \E h \in Hosts : TakeRegionLock(h) \/ EndLadderWrite(h) \/ DropLocks(h)
                        \/ FallSlow(h) \/ ComeBack(h)
    \/ \E h \in Hosts, b \in Brackets : TakeBracketLock(h, b) \/ BeginLadderWrite(h, b)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ SF_vars(EndLadderWrite("hostRookery"))
    /\ SF_vars(EndLadderWrite("hostSpire"))
    /\ WF_vars(ComeBack("hostRookery"))
    /\ WF_vars(ComeBack("hostSpire"))

WriterHoldsItsBracket ==
    ladderWrite.by # Nobody => bracketLock[ladderWrite.bracket] = ladderWrite.by

WritesAlwaysEnd == (ladderWrite.by # Nobody) ~> (ladderWrite.by = Nobody)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT WriterHoldsItsBracket
PROPERTY WritesAlwaysEnd
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker keeps one ranked ladder file, and the ladder writer is
the critical resource: only one lobby host may be writing the ladder at any moment, and the
ladder records who is writing it and for which skill bracket.

Writing is protected by two levels of lock, coarse before fine. A host takes the region
lock first, which covers the whole matchmaking region, and only while holding it may it
take the lock on an individual skill bracket. The region lock is not handed back early:
the host keeps it and the bracket lock together for the whole job, and drops both at once
at the end. A host holding the region lock and a bracket lock may begin a ladder write for
that bracket if nobody else is writing; the write ends when the host is done with it. A
host only drops its locks once it is not the one writing.

Lobby hosts are slow, never failed. A host can fall into a slow spell where it takes no
locks, begins no writes, ends no writes and releases nothing, and it comes out of the spell
on its own. Nothing is ever taken from a slow host -- there is no timeout and no sweeper --
because a slow host is known to be coming back.

Actions: a host that is not slow takes the free region lock; a host holding the region lock
takes a free bracket lock; a host holding both begins a ladder write for its bracket while
the ladder is free; the writing host ends its ladder write; a host that is not writing
drops the region lock and all of its bracket locks; a host falls into a slow spell; a host
comes out of a slow spell.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the ladder file has a write in progress, the host named on it
holds the lock on the very bracket being written, so two hosts can never be writing the
ladder at once and no host writes a bracket it does not hold.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every ladder write that begins eventually ends, so the ladder file is
never left with a write in progress forever.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m3p3t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS SlotCount, MaxServed

Systems == {"mainTower", "annex"}
Dispatchers == {"dispPrimary", "dispBackup"}
Slots == 1..SlotCount
NoSeat == "noSeat"
FreeSlot == "freeSlot"
NoSlot == 0

VARIABLES leaderSeat, schedule, ownSlot, served

vars == <<leaderSeat, schedule, ownSlot, served>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaderSeat \in [Systems -> Dispatchers \cup {NoSeat}]
    /\ schedule \in [Slots -> Systems \cup {FreeSlot}]
    /\ ownSlot \in [Systems -> Slots \cup {NoSlot}]
    /\ served \in [Systems -> 0..MaxServed]

Init ==
    /\ leaderSeat = [i \in Systems |-> NoSeat]
    /\ schedule = [s \in Slots |-> FreeSlot]
    /\ ownSlot = [i \in Systems |-> NoSlot]
    /\ served = [i \in Systems |-> 0]

ElectDispatcher(i, d) ==
    /\ leaderSeat[i] = NoSeat
    /\ leaderSeat' = [leaderSeat EXCEPT ![i] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<schedule, ownSlot, served>>

LeaderFails(i) ==
    /\ leaderSeat[i] # NoSeat
    /\ leaderSeat' = [leaderSeat EXCEPT ![i] = NoSeat]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<schedule, ownSlot, served>>

AllocateSlot(i, s) ==
    /\ leaderSeat[i] # NoSeat
    /\ ownSlot[i] = NoSlot
    /\ schedule[s] = FreeSlot
    /\ schedule' = [schedule EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ ownSlot' = [ownSlot EXCEPT ![i] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, served>>

GiveBackSlot(i) ==
    /\ leaderSeat[i] # NoSeat
    /\ ownSlot[i] # NoSlot
    /\ served[i] < MaxServed
    /\ schedule' = [schedule EXCEPT ![ownSlot[i]] = FreeSlot]
    /\ ownSlot' = [ownSlot EXCEPT ![i] = NoSlot]
    /\ served' = [served EXCEPT ![i] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED leaderSeat

RollOffReport(i) ==
    /\ served[i] > 0
    /\ served' = [served EXCEPT ![i] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, schedule, ownSlot>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Systems, d \in Dispatchers : ElectDispatcher(i, d)
    \/ \E i \in Systems, s \in Slots : AllocateSlot(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Systems : LeaderFails(i) \/ GiveBackSlot(i) \/ RollOffReport(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllocatedSlotsAreRecorded ==
    \A s \in Slots : schedule[s] # FreeSlot => ownSlot[schedule[s]] = s
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    SlotCount = 2
    MaxServed = 2
INVARIANT AllocatedSlotsAreRecorded
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper is dispatched by two independent building systems -- the
main-tower system and the annex system -- that share one dispatch schedule. The schedule is
divided into numbered dispatch slots, and a slot may be allocated to at most one of the two
systems: both systems driving cars from the same slot would put two cars on one call.

Each system runs its own dispatchers and elects one of them as its dispatch leader. A
system without a seated leader does nothing at all. A leader can fail at any time, leaving
its system's seat empty until another of its dispatchers is elected.

A system with a seated leader and no slot of its own may allocate a free slot: the shared
schedule records the slot as that system's, and the system records which slot it took. When
it is done, the leader gives the slot back, clearing the schedule entry and its own record
together, and the system counts one more served call.

Actions: a system elects one of its dispatchers into the empty leader seat; a system's
seated leader fails, emptying the seat; a system with a leader and no slot allocates a free
dispatch slot; a system's leader gives its slot back and counts a served call; a system's
served-call counter is rolled off into the day's report.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every dispatch slot that the shared schedule shows as allocated is the
very slot that its owning system records itself as holding, so no slot is ever allocated to
both systems at once.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m4p1t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxVersion, QueueCap, CountRing

Techs == {"benchIris", "benchJuno", "benchKerr"}
NoStamp == MaxVersion + 1

VARIABLES recVersion, writtenOn, queuedStamp, unitCount

vars == <<recVersion, writtenOn, queuedStamp, unitCount>>

Queued == {t \in Techs : queuedStamp[t] # NoStamp}

TypeOK ==
    /\ recVersion \in 0..MaxVersion
    /\ writtenOn \subseteq 0..MaxVersion
    /\ queuedStamp \in [Techs -> 0..(MaxVersion + 1)]
    /\ unitCount \in 0..(CountRing - 1)

Init ==
    /\ recVersion = 0
    /\ writtenOn = {}
    /\ queuedStamp = [t \in Techs |-> NoStamp]
    /\ unitCount = 0

QueueAmendment(t) ==
    /\ queuedStamp[t] = NoStamp
    /\ Cardinality(Queued) < QueueCap
    /\ queuedStamp' = [queuedStamp EXCEPT ![t] = recVersion]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVersion, writtenOn, unitCount>>

AcceptAmendment(t) ==
    /\ queuedStamp[t] = recVersion
    /\ recVersion < MaxVersion
    /\ writtenOn' = writtenOn \cup {recVersion}
    /\ recVersion' = recVersion + 1
    /\ unitCount' = (unitCount + 1) % CountRing
    /\ queuedStamp' = [queuedStamp EXCEPT ![t] = NoStamp]

RejectOvertaken(t) ==
    /\ queuedStamp[t] # NoStamp
    /\ queuedStamp[t] # recVersion
    /\ queuedStamp' = [queuedStamp EXCEPT ![t] = NoStamp]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVersion, writtenOn, unitCount>>

WithdrawAmendment(t) ==
    /\ queuedStamp[t] # NoStamp
    /\ queuedStamp' = [queuedStamp EXCEPT ![t] = NoStamp]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVersion, writtenOn, unitCount>>

Next ==
    \E t \in Techs :
        QueueAmendment(t) \/ AcceptAmendment(t) \/ RejectOvertaken(t) \/ WithdrawAmendment(t)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(WithdrawAmendment("benchIris"))
    /\ WF_vars(WithdrawAmendment("benchJuno"))
    /\ WF_vars(WithdrawAmendment("benchKerr"))

WrittenVersionsAreTheRunBelow ==
    writtenOn = {k \in 0..MaxVersion : k < recVersion}

QueueAlwaysEmpties ==
    \A t \in Techs : (queuedStamp[t] # NoStamp) ~> (queuedStamp[t] = NoStamp)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MaxVersion = 3
    QueueCap = 2
    CountRing = 3
INVARIANT WrittenVersionsAreTheRunBelow
PROPERTY QueueAlwaysEmpties
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps one shared unit-count record with a version number
beside it, and it keeps the set of version numbers that amendments have already been
written on top of.

Bench technicians amend the record through a bounded update queue. Queuing an amendment
reads the record's current version and stamps the amendment with it; the queue is bounded
and applies backpressure, so while it is full no further amendment is queued, and a
technician has at most one amendment queued at a time.

The link between the benches and the tracker gives no ordering guarantee -- amendments
arrive in whatever order the network feels like -- so the tracker does not work the queue
in order. It picks whichever queued amendment it likes and accepts it only if the version
stamped on it is still the record's current version. Accepting an amendment records that
version as written-on, moves the unit count, and ticks the record's version by one. A
queued amendment stamped with a version the record has moved past is rejected off the
queue. A technician may also simply withdraw an amendment it has queued.

Actions: a technician queues an amendment stamped with the record's current version, while
the queue has room; the tracker accepts a queued amendment whose stamp is still current,
recording the version as written-on and ticking the record; the tracker rejects a queued
amendment whose stamp has been overtaken; a technician withdraws an amendment it queued.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The set of versions that amendments have been written on top of is
exactly the run of versions below the record's current version, so every version from the
start up to the present was built on exactly once and no amendment was ever lost under
another.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every amendment that reaches the queue eventually leaves it, so nothing
sits queued forever unaccepted, unrejected and unwithdrawn.

spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m9p1t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS MaxEpoch, MaxVersion, MinBays, MaxBays

Pharmacists == {"phmQuinn", "phmRosa"}
NoDraft == [ep |-> 0, saw |-> MaxVersion + 1]

VARIABLES epoch, namedWriter, formVersion, draft, baysInService

vars == <<epoch, namedWriter, formVersion, draft, baysInService>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ namedWriter \in Pharmacists
    /\ formVersion \in 0..MaxVersion
    /\ draft \in [Pharmacists -> [ep : 0..MaxEpoch, saw : 0..(MaxVersion + 1)]]
    /\ baysInService \in MinBays..MaxBays

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ namedWriter = "phmQuinn"
    /\ formVersion = 0
    /\ draft = [p \in Pharmacists |-> NoDraft]
    /\ baysInService = MaxBays

RollEpoch(p) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ namedWriter' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<formVersion, draft, baysInService>>

TakeDraft(p) ==
    /\ namedWriter = p
    /\ draft[p] = NoDraft
    /\ draft' = [draft EXCEPT ![p] = [ep |-> epoch, saw |-> formVersion]]

    /\ draft[p].ep = epoch
    /\ namedWriter = p
    /\ draft[p].saw = formVersion
    /\ formVersion < MaxVersion
    /\ baysInService > 0
    /\ formVersion' = formVersion + 1
    /\ draft' = [draft EXCEPT ![p] = NoDraft]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, namedWriter, baysInService>>

ThrowAwayRolledDraft(p) ==
    /\ draft[p] # NoDraft
    /\ draft[p].ep # epoch
    /\ draft' = [draft EXCEPT ![p] = NoDraft]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, namedWriter, formVersion, baysInService>>

    /\ baysInService < MaxBays
    /\ baysInService' = baysInService + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, namedWriter, formVersion, draft>>

    /\ baysInService > MinBays
    /\ baysInService' = baysInService - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, namedWriter, formVersion, draft>>

Next ==
    \/ OpenBay \/ TakeBayOutOfService
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists :
           RollEpoch(p) \/ TakeDraft(p) \/ PublishDraft(p) \/ ThrowAwayRolledDraft(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CurrentEpochDraftIsCurrent ==
    \A p \in Pharmacists :
        (draft[p] # NoDraft /\ draft[p].ep = epoch) => draft[p].saw = formVersion
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxVersion = 2
    MinBays = 0
    MaxBays = 2
INVARIANT CurrentEpochDraftIsCurrent
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser keeps one formulary record, and the record carries a
version number that ticks up every time it is amended. The dispensing cluster runs under an
epoch-numbered configuration: each configuration names exactly one pharmacist as the
formulary writer, and rolling to a new configuration bumps the epoch by one and names
whoever the new configuration nominates.

Amending is a read-modify-write. The pharmacist named as writer takes a draft, which
records the epoch it was taken in and the version it read. Later it publishes the draft,
which is accepted only if the epoch stamped on the draft is still the cluster's epoch, the
pharmacist is still the named writer, and the version it read is still the version on the
record; publishing ticks the version and clears the draft.

Reconfiguration does not stop anything or clean anything up. A draft taken under an epoch
the cluster has rolled past simply becomes unpublishable, and its holder throws it away in
its own time. A pharmacist takes a new draft only once it is carrying none.

The dispenser's bay capacity changes while it runs: bays are opened and taken out of
service through the day, and a publication only goes through while at least one bay is in
service to load the amended formulary into.

Actions: the cluster rolls to a new epoch naming a pharmacist as writer; the named writer
takes a draft of the formulary; the writer publishes a draft that is still current in epoch
and version while a bay is in service; a pharmacist throws away a draft from a rolled-past
epoch; a bay is opened; a bay is taken out of service.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any draft taken in the cluster's current epoch still records the
formulary's current version, so no publication can ever be written on top of a version its
author never read.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m3p0t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Servers, TicketRing

Vacant == "vacant"
Nobody == "nobody"
PrinterIdle == [by |-> Nobody, ticket |-> 0]

VARIABLES leaderSeat, printer, ticketOf, crashed

vars == <<leaderSeat, printer, ticketOf, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaderSeat \in Servers \cup {Vacant}
    /\ printer \in [by : Servers \cup {Nobody}, ticket : 0..(TicketRing - 1)]
    /\ ticketOf \in [Servers -> 0..(TicketRing - 1)]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Servers

Init ==
    /\ leaderSeat = Vacant
    /\ printer = PrinterIdle
    /\ ticketOf = [s \in Servers |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

ElectLeader(s) ==
    /\ leaderSeat = Vacant
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ leaderSeat' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<printer, ticketOf, crashed>>

StandDown(s) ==
    /\ leaderSeat = s
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ printer.by # s
    /\ leaderSeat' = Vacant
    /\ UNCHANGED <<printer, ticketOf, crashed>>

NextTicket(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ printer.by # s
    /\ ticketOf' = [ticketOf EXCEPT ![s] = (@ + 1) % TicketRing]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, printer, crashed>>

StartPrint(s) ==
    /\ leaderSeat = s
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ printer.by = Nobody
    /\ printer' = [by |-> s, ticket |-> ticketOf[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, ticketOf, crashed>>

FinishPrint ==
    /\ printer.by # Nobody
    /\ printer' = PrinterIdle
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, ticketOf, crashed>>

CrashSilently(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, printer, ticketOf>>

WatchdogCleansUp(s) ==
    /\ s \in crashed
    /\ \/ leaderSeat = s
       \/ printer.by = s
    /\ leaderSeat' = IF leaderSeat = s THEN Vacant ELSE leaderSeat
    /\ printer' = IF printer.by = s THEN PrinterIdle ELSE printer
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ticketOf, crashed>>

RestartServer(s) ==
    /\ s \in crashed
    /\ leaderSeat # s
    /\ printer.by # s
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderSeat, printer, ticketOf>>

Next ==
    \/ FinishPrint
    \/ \E s \in Servers :
           \/ ElectLeader(s) \/ StandDown(s) \/ NextTicket(s) \/ StartPrint(s)
           \/ CrashSilently(s) \/ WatchdogCleansUp(s) \/ RestartServer(s)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(FinishPrint)

SlipBelongsToLeader ==
    printer.by # Nobody =>
        /\ leaderSeat = printer.by
        /\ ticketOf[printer.by] = printer.ticket

PrinterAlwaysClears == (printer.by # Nobody) ~> (printer.by = Nobody)

cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Servers = {srvOak, srvElm}
    TicketRing = 3
INVARIANT SlipBelongsToLeader
PROPERTY PrinterAlwaysClears
nl:
A library book reservation system runs on a handful of branch servers that share one hold-
slip printer at the collection desk. The printer is the critical resource: only one server
may have a slip on it at a time, and the slip on the printer carries the ticket number of
the job that put it there.

The servers elect a leader, and only the elected leader may put a slip on the printer. A
leader stands down voluntarily, leaving the seat vacant for another server to be elected
into, but never while it has a slip on the printer. Each server works through its own
ticket numbers, moving to its next ticket between jobs; a server does not change ticket
while its slip is on the printer. Starting a print stamps the server's current ticket onto
the printer; the printer finishes the slip and goes idle again.

A branch server can crash silently. Nothing announces it: the server stops standing for
election, stops taking tickets and stops printing, and it may be crashed while holding the
leader seat, or with its slip still on the printer, or both. The desk watchdog cleans up
after a crashed server: it vacates the seat if the crashed server was holding it and takes
that server's slip off the printer, in one step. A crashed server that no longer holds the
seat and has nothing on the printer can be restarted.

Actions: a live server is elected into the vacant leader seat; the leader stands down when
it has nothing on the printer; a server that is not printing moves on to its next ticket;
the leader puts a slip on the free printer stamped with its current ticket; the printer
finishes the slip and goes idle; a server crashes silently; the watchdog vacates the seat
and clears the printer for a crashed server; a cleaned-up crashed server restarts.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever there is a slip on the printer, it belongs to the server that
currently holds the leader seat and carries that server's current ticket number, so two
servers can never have slips on the printer at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every slip that goes onto the printer eventually comes off it, so the
printer is never left occupied forever.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m3p1t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxTerm, CountRing

Robots == {"botPicker", "botStacker"}
Empty == "emptySeat"
NoDelegation == [tm |-> 0, base |-> CountRing]

VARIABLES term, seat, shelfCount, delegation, slowSpell

vars == <<term, seat, shelfCount, delegation, slowSpell>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ seat \in Controllers \cup {Empty}
    /\ shelfCount \in 0..(CountRing - 1)
    /\ delegation \in [Robots -> [tm : 0..MaxTerm, base : 0..CountRing]]
    /\ slowSpell \subseteq Robots

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ seat = Empty
    /\ shelfCount = 0
    /\ delegation = [r \in Robots |-> NoDelegation]
    /\ slowSpell = {}

StandForElection(c) ==
    /\ seat = Empty
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ seat' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfCount, delegation, slowSpell>>

ControllerFails ==
    /\ seat # Empty
    /\ seat' = Empty
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, shelfCount, delegation, slowSpell>>

StampDelegation(r) ==
    /\ seat # Empty
    /\ delegation[r] = NoDelegation
    /\ \A q \in Robots : ~(delegation[q] # NoDelegation /\ delegation[q].tm = term)
    /\ delegation' = [delegation EXCEPT ![r] = [tm |-> term, base |-> shelfCount]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seat, shelfCount, slowSpell>>

RobotWrites(r) ==
    /\ r \notin slowSpell
    /\ delegation[r] # NoDelegation
    /\ delegation[r].tm = term
    /\ delegation[r].base = shelfCount
    /\ shelfCount' = (shelfCount + 1) % CountRing
    /\ delegation' = [delegation EXCEPT ![r] = NoDelegation]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seat, slowSpell>>

DropStaleDelegation(r) ==
    /\ r \notin slowSpell
    /\ delegation[r] # NoDelegation
    /\ delegation[r].tm # term
    /\ delegation' = [delegation EXCEPT ![r] = NoDelegation]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seat, shelfCount, slowSpell>>

FallSlow(r) ==
    /\ r \notin slowSpell
    /\ slowSpell' = slowSpell \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seat, shelfCount, delegation>>

ComeRound(r) ==
    /\ r \in slowSpell
    /\ slowSpell' = slowSpell \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seat, shelfCount, delegation>>

Next ==
    \/ ControllerFails
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : StandForElection(c)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : StampDelegation(r) \/ RobotWrites(r) \/ DropStaleDelegation(r)
                         \/ FallSlow(r) \/ ComeRound(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CurrentDelegationSeesCurrentCount ==
    \A r \in Robots :
        (delegation[r] # NoDelegation /\ delegation[r].tm = term) =>
            delegation[r].base = shelfCount
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {ctlPrime, ctlSpare}
    MaxTerm = 2
    CountRing = 3
INVARIANT CurrentDelegationSeesCurrentCount
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet keeps one shared shelf-count record for the pick face. The fleet
runs under a controller elected for a numbered term: standing for election raises the term
by one and seats that controller, and a seated controller can fail, leaving the seat empty
until another is elected.

Robots do not write the record on their own initiative. The seated controller hands out a
delegation: it picks a robot and stamps the delegation with the current term and with the
shelf count as it stands at that moment. The controller keeps only one delegation alive at
a time -- it will not stamp a new one while another delegation from the current term is
still out.

A robot with a delegation writes the record, and the write is accepted only if the
delegation's term is still the fleet's term and the count stamped on it is still the count
on the record; the write moves the count on and consumes the delegation. A delegation
stamped with a term the fleet has moved past can never be written, and the robot holding it
drops it.

Robots are slow, never failed. A robot can fall into a slow spell in which it does not
write and does not drop anything, and it comes out of the spell on its own. Nothing is
reclaimed from a slow robot: a delegation in a slow robot's hands stays there, and the
controller keeps waiting rather than stamping a second one.

Actions: a controller stands for election, raising the term and taking the seat; the seated
controller fails, emptying the seat; the seated controller stamps a delegation for a robot
with the current term and shelf count; a robot that is not slow writes the record under a
delegation that is still current in both term and count; a robot drops a delegation from a
term the fleet has moved past.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any delegation still stamped with the fleet's current term carries the
shelf-count record's current value, so no robot can ever write a count on top of a change it
never saw.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m3p1t5 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS StampRing, MaxLevel

Coordinators == {"coordFalls", "coordGorge"}
Vacant == "vacant"
NoProposal == StampRing

VARIABLES seat, planStamp, proposal, shedLevel

vars == <<seat, planStamp, proposal, shedLevel>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ seat \in Coordinators \cup {Vacant}
    /\ planStamp \in 0..(StampRing - 1)
    /\ proposal \in [Coordinators -> 0..StampRing]
    /\ shedLevel \in 0..MaxLevel

Init ==
    /\ seat = Vacant
    /\ planStamp = 0
    /\ proposal = [c \in Coordinators |-> NoProposal]
    /\ shedLevel = 0

TakeSeat(c) ==
    /\ seat = Vacant
    /\ seat' = c
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![c] = NoProposal]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<planStamp, shedLevel>>

SeatedCoordinatorFails ==
    /\ seat # Vacant
    /\ seat' = Vacant
    /\ UNCHANGED <<planStamp, proposal, shedLevel>>

DraftProposal(c) ==
    /\ seat = c
    /\ proposal[c] = NoProposal
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![c] = planStamp]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seat, planStamp, shedLevel>>

CommitProposal(c) ==
    /\ seat = c
    /\ proposal[c] = planStamp
    /\ planStamp' = (planStamp + 1) % StampRing
    /\ shedLevel' = (shedLevel + 1) % (MaxLevel + 1)
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![c] = NoProposal]
    /\ UNCHANGED seat

DiscardProposal(c) ==
    /\ proposal[c] # NoProposal
    /\ ~(seat = c /\ proposal[c] = planStamp)
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![c] = NoProposal]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seat, planStamp, shedLevel>>

OperatorOverride(lvl) ==
    /\ seat' = Vacant
    /\ shedLevel' = lvl
    /\ planStamp' = (planStamp + 1) % StampRing
    /\ UNCHANGED proposal

Next ==
    \/ SeatedCoordinatorFails
    \/ \E lvl \in 0..MaxLevel : OperatorOverride(lvl)
    \/ \E c \in Coordinators : TakeSeat(c) \/ DraftProposal(c) \/ CommitProposal(c)
                               \/ DiscardProposal(c)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(CommitProposal("coordFalls") \/ DiscardProposal("coordFalls"))
    /\ WF_vars(CommitProposal("coordGorge") \/ DiscardProposal("coordGorge"))

SeatedProposalIsCurrent ==
    \A c \in Coordinators :
        (seat = c /\ proposal[c] # NoProposal) => proposal[c] = planStamp

ProposalsAlwaysSettle ==
    \A c \in Coordinators : (proposal[c] # NoProposal) ~> (proposal[c] = NoProposal)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    StampRing = 3
    MaxLevel = 2
INVARIANT SeatedProposalIsCurrent
PROPERTY ProposalsAlwaysSettle
nl:
A power-grid load shedder works from one shared shed plan, and the plan carries a revision
stamp that moves on every time the plan is rewritten. The shedder's coordinators elect one
of themselves into the planning seat; a seated coordinator can fail, leaving the seat
vacant for another to be elected into. A coordinator taking the seat always starts clean:
whatever proposal it was still carrying is dropped at that moment.

Rewriting the plan is a read-modify-write. The seated coordinator drafts a proposal,
recording the revision stamp it read. It commits the proposal later, and the commit is
allowed only if it still holds the seat and the stamp it recorded is still the stamp on the
plan; committing moves the shed level on and ticks the stamp. A proposal that can no longer
be committed -- because its author lost the seat, or because the plan moved on underneath
it -- is discarded rather than applied.

The grid operator has a privileged override for emergencies. The operator can seize the
planning seat outright, leaving it vacant, and write a shed level straight into the plan,
ticking the stamp as it goes. The override needs no proposal, no seat and no agreement, and
it can be invoked at any moment, including while a coordinator is holding a drafted
proposal.

Actions: a coordinator is elected into the vacant planning seat and drops any proposal it
carried; the seated coordinator fails, vacating the seat; the seated coordinator drafts a
proposal recording the plan's stamp; the seated coordinator commits a proposal that is
still current, moving the shed level and ticking the stamp; a coordinator discards a
proposal that can no longer be committed; the operator's override vacates the seat, writes
a shed level and ticks the stamp.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any proposal still held by the coordinator that currently occupies the
planning seat records the plan's current revision stamp, so no commit can ever overwrite a
plan revision its author never read.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every proposal a coordinator drafts is eventually gone from that
coordinator, so no draft is left hanging without being either committed or discarded.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m1p0t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS RingSize, MaxReady

Lobbies == 0..(RingSize - 1)
Nobody == RingSize

Dist(a, b) == ((b + RingSize) - a) % RingSize

VARIABLES onRing, token, atGate, readyCount

vars == <<onRing, token, atGate, readyCount>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ onRing \subseteq Lobbies
    /\ token \in Lobbies
    /\ atGate \in Lobbies \cup {Nobody}
    /\ readyCount \in [Lobbies -> 0..MaxReady]

Init ==
    /\ onRing = Lobbies
    /\ token = 0
    /\ atGate = Nobody
    /\ readyCount = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]

JoinRing(l) ==
    /\ l \notin onRing
    /\ onRing' = onRing \cup {l}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, atGate, readyCount>>

LeaveRing(l) ==
    /\ l \in onRing
    /\ l # token
    /\ l # atGate
    /\ onRing' = onRing \ {l}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, atGate, readyCount>>

PassToken(m) ==
    /\ atGate = Nobody
    /\ m \in onRing
    /\ m # token
    /\ \A k \in onRing : k # token => Dist(token, m) <= Dist(token, k)
    /\ token' = m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRing, atGate, readyCount>>

BeginMatchStart(l) ==
    /\ token = l
    /\ l \in onRing
    /\ atGate = Nobody
    /\ readyCount[l] > 0
    /\ atGate' = l
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRing, token, readyCount>>

FinishMatchStart(l) ==
    /\ atGate = l
    /\ atGate' = Nobody
    /\ readyCount' = [readyCount EXCEPT ![l] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRing, token>>

PlayerReady(l) ==
    /\ readyCount[l] < MaxReady
    /\ readyCount' = [readyCount EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRing, token, atGate>>

PlayerDropsOut(l) ==
    /\ readyCount[l] > 0
    /\ readyCount' = [readyCount EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRing, token, atGate>>

Next ==
    \E l \in Lobbies :
        \/ JoinRing(l) \/ LeaveRing(l) \/ PassToken(l)
        \/ BeginMatchStart(l) \/ FinishMatchStart(l) \/ PlayerReady(l) \/ PlayerDropsOut(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

GateHolderHoldsTheToken ==
    atGate # Nobody => (token = atGate /\ atGate \in onRing)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    RingSize = 3
    MaxReady = 2
INVARIANT GateHolderHoldsTheToken
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker runs a set of lobbies around a token ring. The match-
start gate is the critical resource: the backend can bring exactly one match up at a time,
so only one lobby may be at the gate.

The ring token is what grants the gate. A lobby may only begin a match start while it is
holding the token, and it must have at least one player ready. Beginning a start puts that
lobby at the gate; finishing the start clears the gate and empties that lobby's ready list.
The token only moves while the gate is clear, and it always moves to the next lobby round
the ring: of all the other lobbies currently on the ring, the token goes to the one nearest
in ring order.

Ring membership changes while the matchmaker runs, because lobbies are spun up and torn
down with demand. A lobby joins the ring at its own position. A lobby may only leave the
ring when it is neither holding the token nor sitting at the match-start gate, so the token
is never stranded on a lobby that has gone away and the gate is never left occupied by one.

Players make themselves ready in a lobby and drop out of a lobby's ready list.

Actions: a lobby joins the ring; a lobby that holds neither the token nor the gate leaves
the ring; the token moves to the nearest other lobby on the ring while the gate is clear;
the token-holding lobby with a ready player begins a match start; a lobby at the gate
finishes its start and empties its ready list; a player makes ready in a lobby; a player
drops out of a lobby's ready list.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any lobby sitting at the match-start gate is the lobby currently holding
the ring token and is still a member of the ring, so two lobbies can never be at the gate
at once.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m5p4t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANT ShedCapacity

Relays == {"relayOne", "relayTwo", "relayThree"}
Feeders == {"fdrHarbour", "fdrValley"}
NoFeeder == "noFeeder"

VARIABLES proposed, busVotes, counted, shedSet

vars == <<proposed, busVotes, counted, shedSet>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposed \in Feeders \cup {NoFeeder}
    /\ busVotes \subseteq [by : Relays, feeder : Feeders]
    /\ counted \subseteq Relays
    /\ shedSet \subseteq Feeders

Init ==
    /\ proposed = NoFeeder
    /\ busVotes = {}
    /\ counted = {}
    /\ shedSet = {}

PutUpProposal(f) ==
    /\ proposed = NoFeeder
    /\ f \notin shedSet
    /\ Cardinality(shedSet) < ShedCapacity
    /\ proposed' = f
    /\ counted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busVotes, shedSet>>

RelayVotes(r, f) ==
    /\ [by |-> r, feeder |-> f] \notin busVotes
    /\ busVotes' = busVotes \cup {[by |-> r, feeder |-> f]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, counted, shedSet>>

CountBusVote(r, f) ==
    /\ [by |-> r, feeder |-> f] \in busVotes
    /\ proposed = f
    /\ counted' = counted \cup {r}
    /\ busVotes' = busVotes \ {[by |-> r, feeder |-> f]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, shedSet>>

DropBusVote(r, f) ==
    /\ [by |-> r, feeder |-> f] \in busVotes
    /\ proposed # f
    /\ busVotes' = busVotes \ {[by |-> r, feeder |-> f]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, counted, shedSet>>

ShedExecutes ==
    /\ proposed # NoFeeder
    /\ Cardinality(counted) * 2 > Cardinality(Relays)
    /\ shedSet' = shedSet \cup {proposed}
    /\ proposed' = NoFeeder
    /\ counted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED busVotes

AbandonProposal ==
    /\ proposed # NoFeeder
    /\ proposed' = NoFeeder
    /\ counted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busVotes, shedSet>>

RestoreFeeder(f) ==
    /\ f \in shedSet
    /\ shedSet' = shedSet \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, busVotes, counted>>

Next ==
    \/ ShedExecutes \/ AbandonProposal
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : PutUpProposal(f) \/ RestoreFeeder(f)
    \/ \E r \in Relays, f \in Feeders : RelayVotes(r, f) \/ CountBusVote(r, f) \/ DropBusVote(r, f)

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(AbandonProposal)

ShedCapacityRespected ==
    Cardinality(shedSet) + (IF proposed = NoFeeder THEN 0 ELSE 1) <= ShedCapacity

ProposalsAlwaysClose == (proposed # NoFeeder) ~> (proposed = NoFeeder)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    ShedCapacity = 1
INVARIANT ShedCapacityRespected
PROPERTY ProposalsAlwaysClose
nl:
A power-grid load shedder may have only so many feeders shed at once; that ceiling is the
grid's shed capacity and it must never be breached. Shedding is agreed by quorum: the
coordinator puts up one feeder at a time and the three substation relays vote on it.

Relay votes travel over the telemetry bus, which reorders freely. A relay simply puts a
vote for a feeder onto the bus whenever it likes -- it may vote for a feeder before the
coordinator has proposed it, or long after the coordinator has moved on. The coordinator
takes a vote off the bus and counts it only when the feeder it names is the feeder
currently proposed; a vote naming any other feeder is dropped off the bus uncounted.

A proposal may only be put up while the shed capacity has room for one more feeder, and the
feeder proposed must not already be shed. Once a strict majority of relays have been
counted for the proposal, the shed executes: the feeder joins the shed set and the proposal
closes with its tally wiped. The coordinator may also abandon a proposal at any point,
which closes it and wipes the tally. A shed feeder is restored when the grid recovers,
freeing its place under the capacity.

Actions: the coordinator puts up a feeder that is not already shed while capacity allows; a
relay puts a vote for some feeder onto the telemetry bus; the coordinator counts a bus vote
that names the proposed feeder; the coordinator drops a bus vote that names anything else;
the shed executes once a majority has been counted; the coordinator abandons the proposal;
a shed feeder is restored.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The feeders already shed, plus the one feeder held by an open proposal,
never exceed the grid's shed capacity.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every proposal the coordinator puts up is eventually closed, so the
coordinator never sits on an open proposal forever.

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANT SlotCount

Engines == {"engAlpha", "engBeta"}
Clearers == {"clrOne", "clrTwo"}
Slots == 1..SlotCount
FreeSlot == "freeSlot"
NoSlot == 0
NoEngine == "noEngine"

VARIABLES slotOwner, txnSlot, txnFor, txnPhase, tally, crashed

    /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> Engines \cup {FreeSlot}]
    /\ txnSlot \in Slots \cup {NoSlot}
    /\ txnFor \in Engines \cup {NoEngine}
    /\ txnPhase \in {"idle", "voting", "prepared"}
    /\ tally \subseteq Clearers
    /\ crashed \subseteq Clearers

    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> FreeSlot]
    /\ txnSlot = NoSlot
    /\ txnFor = NoEngine
    /\ txnPhase = "idle"
    /\ tally = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

BeginTransaction(e, s) ==
    /\ txnPhase = "idle"
    /\ slotOwner[s] = FreeSlot
    /\ txnSlot' = s
    /\ txnFor' = e
    /\ txnPhase' = "voting"
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, crashed>>

ClearerVotes(c) ==
    /\ txnPhase = "voting"
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ c \notin tally
    /\ tally' = tally \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, txnSlot, txnFor, txnPhase, crashed>>

MoveToPrepared ==
    /\ txnPhase = "voting"
    /\ tally = Clearers
    /\ txnPhase' = "prepared"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, txnSlot, txnFor, tally, crashed>>

CommitTransaction ==
    /\ txnPhase = "prepared"
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![txnSlot] = txnFor]
    /\ txnSlot' = NoSlot
    /\ txnFor' = NoEngine
    /\ txnPhase' = "idle"
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

AbortTransaction ==
    /\ txnPhase # "idle"
    /\ txnSlot' = NoSlot
    /\ txnFor' = NoEngine
    /\ txnPhase' = "idle"
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, crashed>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<txnSlot, txnFor, txnPhase, tally, crashed>>

    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, txnSlot, txnFor, txnPhase, tally>>

    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, txnSlot, txnFor, txnPhase, tally>>

    \/ \E e \in Engines, s \in Slots : BeginTransaction(e, s)

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    SlotCount = 2
INVARIANT InFlightSlotIsStillFree
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction divides its print into numbered allocation slots, and a
slot may be allocated to at most one matching engine -- two engines printing into the same
slot would cross the same shares twice.

Slots are allocated by two-phase commit across the clearing participants. The coordinator
begins a transaction for one engine and one slot, and only for a slot that is free right
then; the transaction goes into its voting phase with an empty tally. Every clearing
participant votes, and once all of them have voted the transaction moves to prepared. A
prepared transaction commits by writing the engine into the slot, which closes the
transaction and wipes the tally. A transaction in either phase can be aborted instead,
which closes it and wipes the tally without writing anything. A slot that has been
allocated can be released when the print for it is done.

A clearing participant can crash silently. Nothing announces it: the participant simply
stops voting, so a transaction waiting on its vote never reaches prepared and has to be
aborted. A crashed participant can be brought back up and votes again from then on.

Actions: the coordinator begins a transaction allocating a free slot to an engine; a live
clearing participant votes for the transaction in its voting phase; a fully-voted
transaction moves to prepared; a prepared transaction commits, writing the engine into the
slot; a transaction is aborted from either phase; an allocated slot is released; a
participant crashes silently; a crashed participant is brought back up.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a transaction is in flight, the slot it is allocating is still
free, so no transaction can ever commit onto a slot that has already been allocated.

PROPERTY DownlinkAlwaysComesBack
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares one satellite downlink. The downlink is the
critical resource: only one drone may hold it, and a drone that holds it believes itself to
be the holder and streams on that basis.

The downlink is handed out by two-phase commit across the swarm. An acquisition begins for
one drone, and only while the downlink is ungranted and that drone does not already believe
it holds it; the transaction enters its voting phase with an empty tally. Every drone in the
swarm votes, and once all of them have voted the transaction moves to prepared. A prepared
transaction commits by granting the downlink: the grant record names the drone and that
drone starts believing it is the holder, both in the same step. A transaction in either
phase can instead be aborted, which closes it without granting anything. The holder gives
the downlink back when it is done streaming, clearing the grant record and its own belief
together.

A drone can crash silently -- it burns out over the fire line and simply stops voting,
stops streaming and never gives the downlink back, possibly while holding it. The swarm
watchdog reclaims from a crashed holder, clearing both the grant record and that drone's
belief in one step. A crashed drone that is not the holder can be recovered and rejoins the
swarm.
